caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher with a wide, rounded body and a small base. The pitcher has a short, curved spout and a sturdy handle attached near the top and bottom of the vessel, both featuring pronounced ridges for grip. The surface of the pitcher displays a textured, cross-hatched pattern that simulates a woven or basket-like appearance. The coloring of the pitcher blends multiple hues including deep greens, rich browns, and subtle yellows, with some areas shaded in purple and blue tones, creating a reflective, iridescent effect. The inside of the pitcher is painted in lighter shades of brown and tan. The background of the drawing is a plain, beige or off-white color, with no other objects or details present, allowing the pitcher to be centrally and prominently displayed.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
